title: FxNorm-Automix Setup Discriminator: IR Substitution vs. No-IR Baseline
purpose: A reusable experiment brief and checklist scaffold for anyone attempting to run FxNorm-Automix inference. The central discriminating question: does supplying your own impulse responses (as the README permits) produce a meaningfully different mix compared to running inference without reverberation augmentation? The package includes a protocol checklist, a stem-layout probe script template, and a results logging template for a two-condition A/B listening comparison.
